recap.paragraph: In Florida, No. 24 Florida chased its first winning SEC record since 2020. Myles Graham raced 57 yards with a fumble for a Gators touchdown! Jared Curtis then zipped a 75-yard touchdown pass to Junior Sherrill, putting Vanderbilt ahead 24-17. Aaron Philo ran in to tie it at 24. With 2:18 left, Jadan Baugh rumbled 10 yards for the winning touchdown! The 34-27 win gave Florida a seventh victory and that winning SEC record.
